description.p: Nix App Center is a declarative app store for Nix. Try first: run a package instantly with Try (nix run), then deliberately keep it in your configuration. Nix App Center owns its own files and only edits yours with your explicit consent, showing the diff first.

Nix App Center est une logithèque déclarative pour Nix. Le principe « try-first » : lancez un paquet instantanément avec « Lancer » (nix run), puis gardez-le délibérément dans votre configuration. Nix App Center écrit ses propres fichiers et ne modifie la vôtre qu'avec votre accord explicite, diff à l'appui.

description.p: Nix Software is now Nix App Center. Links from nixsoftware.org open the package page in the app, and packages Flathub does not know get their name, logo and screenshots from there, with similar apps on each page. Search results have filters you can combine. The interface is translated into Spanish, Portuguese, Chinese, Hindi and Arabic.
A NixOS module, programs.nix-app-center.enable, installs the app with its search provider and polkit. Builds on aarch64-linux, and uses the system gettext.

Installed apps show where and how they are installed: home or system, package or module, Flatpak or AppImage. Apps can switch between those, versions can be held, options set and flake modules imported from search. The configuration builds as the user, so private repositories work, and an Apply button shows whenever something changed.

First release. Search nixpkgs with Flathub metadata, try any app without installing it, keep it in your configuration after an approved diff, and apply in the app. Installed, Updates and Storage tabs, reviews, NixOS option search and GNOME Shell search.
